text: The future of artificial intelligence is a topic that attracts a lot of attention. Most AI systems today are narrow, which means they are designed for specific tasks. However, researchers are working towards general AI, often called AGI, which could understand and learn any task like a human. Supporters believe AGI could bring major benefits, such as solving health and environmental problems. At the same time, experts warn about serious risks, including job losses and safety concerns. Timeline predictions vary widely: some think AGI may arrive within twenty years, while others believe it is much further away.
